title: Sawtooth
subtitle: All-Terrain Tactical Vehicle (ATTV)
description: The "Sawtooth" is a high-mobility, low-profile quadruped platform engineered for pursuit and close-contact engagement over extreme terrain. Its low-slung, feline-pattern frame, digitigrade independent limbs and triple counterbalance tail allow fast stalking, sharp turns and long pounces. A segmented dorsal spine under layered serrated plating combines structural rigidity with low weight, while the jaw assembly and clawed feet provide primary contact weaponry. Lightly armoured joint housings and exposed hydraulic runs trade protection for agility; a dorsal module houses power and control systems.
specs: Segmented spine frame, layered alloy plating
Dorsal module, low centre of gravity
notes: Joint housings are lightly armoured; hydraulic lines stay exposed.
Tail whips counter-rotate in turns; high inertia slows recovery after a missed strike.
Single dorsal module: its loss disables limb actuation.
Sustained sprints raise heat load along the dorsal plating.
